name: cctoolkit
description: The cctoolkit plugin and its optional mods.

plugins.name: cctoolkit
plugins.description: DDD/TDD kit: skills, agents, hooks, presets, business knowledge base, cctoolkit command

plugins.name: context-band
plugins.description: Line under the prompt input, a band above the prompt on the desktop: context meter, cache expiry, single-call streak, 5h limit, session time, turns and cost, top context contributors, graphify rebuild

plugins.name: knowledge-pane
plugins.description: Side pane browsing the business knowledge base: contexts, use cases and their rules, decisions, ADRs, history, a staged merge or sync; and following a /business-spec: decisions and answers, open questions, use cases, business rules, sections, unfolded inline on click; read-only, no model context spent

plugins.name: run-lot-pane
plugins.description: Side pane following a run-lot run, or a run-plan run with a plan view and navigation between its batches: phases as columns, agents (model, duration, tokens per agent, slowness, stalls, retries, interruptions), estimated end, batch sheet, audit verdict and rounds, run outcome with the knowledge-base merge a plan staged, end toast; steers the run: entries to validate, notes, dependency graph
